name: Runeous
source:
The story follows a small group of heroes in a world ravished by the wars of its past. 

Rune stones possessing magical qualities are what fuel the industry, their secrets long ago lost. Humans research them to unlock their hidden potential. Overpopulation in cities built for far fewer inhabitants. Homes built atop homes with giant walkways connecting the various levels together.

The world of Ceir'a faces a new threat. It is here that Leif, a young runic apprentice meets a Jacawi tribeswoman Eme. Together they must overcome the differences of their people and unite the factions to thwart the rising evil empire. Though not all is as it seems when the very fabric of nature begins to fall apart!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1306470064/runeous/description]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一个被过去的战争蹂躏的世界里的一小群英雄的故事。

具有神奇品质的符文石是这个行业的动力，但它们的秘密早已失传。人类研究它们以释放它们隐藏的潜力。为人口少得多而建造的城市人口过剩。房屋建在房屋顶上，巨大的走道将各个楼层连接在一起。

塞拉的世界面临着新的威胁。正是在这里，年轻的符文学徒莱夫遇到了贾卡维部落妇女艾梅。他们必须共同克服人民的分歧，团结各派别，挫败邪恶帝国的崛起。尽管当自然结构开始崩溃时，一切并不像看起来那样！

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1306470064/runeous/description]Kickstarter活动[/url]]
